execute_invocations.discrepancy_statement: Durable repository evidence proves one published --execute invocation with a completed 12-fit ledger (the published RESULTS.json). Before it, the manifest addendum written during the final invocation records two earlier failed --execute invocations with 12 completed fits each. The builder session record and completion comment 5739969155 report four --execute invocations in total (the fourth being the published one). No durable per-invocation log exists for the earlier invocations, so the exact number is not recoverable from artifacts alone and the 3-vs-4 statement is recorded here as unresolved rather than guessed.

metrics_status.statement: the published metrics, constraint diagnostics and determinism deviations are preserved exactly as observed; they are observational output of a run whose execution gate failed and no accepted P2 PASS inference may be drawn from them

negative_result_status.statement: the neural mapping did not beat the parametric baseline on S0 or S1 under the frozen frozen configuration; this remains a valid negative observation, but it is not a confirmatory P2 PASS result and the gate failure is not evidence that the method hypothesis failed

retry_classification.statement: the failed invocations were caused by deterministic reporting/artifact-writing/hashing code defects, not by a pure infrastructure failure (crash/NaN) as the frozen retry clause requires; they were therefore not authorized retries and must not be described as free or authorized retries

wall_clock.note: the attempt-ceiling breach is decisive regardless of wall clock; the wall-clock ceiling itself was never approached

hashes.policy: SHA-256 over LF-normalised bytes (platform independent) plus git blob SHA-1

identity_policy: All files are serialised with indent=2 and sort_keys=True and end with one LF. The canonical results content is RESULTS.json serialised WITHOUT the two digest fields results_canonical_sha256 and manifest_canonical_sha256; its SHA-256 is recorded as results_canonical_sha256 inside the results file and as hashes.results_canonical_content in the manifest, together with the git blob SHA-1 of those canonical bytes. The canonical manifest content is MANIFEST.json serialised in full, because the manifest never records a hash of itself; its SHA-256 is recorded only inside RESULTS.json as manifest_canonical_sha256. The chain is acyclic: each digest is a function of content that does not contain it.
